Course: IE 402 - Systems Engineering
Description: This course introduces students to the principles and practices of systems engineering, focusing on the analysis, design, and management of complex systems. Through a blend of theoretical concepts and practical applications, students learn how to approach and solve large-scale engineering problems involving multiple components, stakeholders, and operational constraints. Week 2: Life-cycle models
Week 3: Requirements analysis
Week 4: Functional decomposition
Week 5: Systems design and trade studies
Week 6: Verification and validation

Course: CPE 304 - Fundamentals of Mixed Signals and Sensors
Description: This course covers operational amplifiers, signal converters, power switching devices and the construction and operation of sensors and transducers for converting physical parameters into electrical signals and vice-versa. The course focuses on the application of these devices in developing signal conversion circuits that allows measurement, processing and control of physical parameters by digital processing systems such as a finite state machine or a digital computer. Topics on actuators are also included.
Weekly topics:
Week 1: Operational amplifier basics
Week 2: Amplifier circuits
Week 3: Signal conditioning
Week 4: Analog-to-digital converters
Week 5: Sensors and transducers
Week 6: Interfacing sensors with a microcontroller
items.target: Cruz, A., & Tan, B. (2022). Operational amplifiers and sensor signal conditioning. Example Press.

basisRule.title_only: The title indicates the subject but the named venue does not.
basisRule.title_and_venue: The title and the venue name each indicate the subject (or the other field for an unrelated entry).
basisRule.insufficient: The entry does not indicate enough about the subject.
basisRule.limitation: The current enum has no venue_only basis. A generic title with a telling venue is a diagnostic, not a scored academic expectation.
